title: Cheese Cloths for Straining, 6PCS 20x20 Inch Grade 100 Cheese Cloth, Reusable Washable Unbleached Pure Cotton Cheesecloth for Cooking and Cheese Making with Hemmed Edge
description:
About this item
NATURAL: Amrules cheesecloth for straining is made from organic pure cotton. It is not dyed or bleached which is completely food grade, so you can enjoy the pleasure of making food without health concern.
HEMMED: The reinforced stitched edges ensures the straining cloth to be durable without lint shedding and prevent tearing easily. Just use the cheese cloths for cooking without worrying about threads falling into foods.
ULTRA FINE: Amrules mesh cotton cloth are weaved elaborately with Grade 100 technology to ensures superior filtration and threads are disbursed averagely, allowing you to achieve refined straining.
REUSABLE: Our cheese cloth is able to withstand repeated straining, filtering, juicing, wrapping, basting and steaming. Residues won’t stayed after washing due to smooth and breath fabric.
VERSATILE: The cloth strainer is perfect for making soft cheeses, butter, yogurt or filtering, decorating, polishing, canning, crafting. It can be used as table runner, roasting turkey, ghost making as well.
TIPS: It comes with 6 Pieces of 20x20 Inches in a vacuum sealed bag. If you see spots on unbleached cheesecloth which are cottonseed hulls. Scrub gently with hands and rinse with running water.

I frequently make chicken broth or beef bone broth and I normally run it through a fine mesh strainer. It leaves some sediment in the broth, which I don't mind and figure is just extra nutrition, but it doesn't look very nice when I'm gifting containers of it to others. This cheese cloth solves that concern. It's easy to clean, too. I just pour a little dish soap on it and wash it by hand under the faucet and let it air dry.
